status: calibrated: on the recovered inputs, the recovered original classifier and the parser-based reconstruction both reproduce every reported category exactly

consumer.publication: Only extracted CSS declarations (property, value, condition and state context), Alpha 1 categories, opaque location digests, pinned consumer commits, input digests and counts are published. Consumer source, selectors, file paths, the original script and private values are not.

noteBlobs.role: revision inspected by the CE research [W1]

originalClassifier.location: An agent session transcript of the consumer integration work on the maintainer's machine. The script was written to a session scratch directory and never committed to the consumer repository or any other repository; the consumer Git history (all branches, pull refs and tags, 629 commits, 4,753 blobs) contains no classifier.
originalClassifier.publicationReason: It was written during the consumer's own work session, so it is treated as consumer material. It is identified by digest and described here; tools/coverage/ is the parser-based replacement that this repository runs.
algorithm: Import propertyKind and structuralAllowed from the Alpha 1 policy module given as an argument.
Remove /* */ comments and @keyframes blocks with regular expressions.
Match every `name: value` followed by `;` or `}` with the expression ([a-z-]+)\s*:\s*([^;{}]+)[;}].
Skip names starting with `--` (custom properties). A second skip for names starting with `webkit` never matches, because vendor names start with `-`.
Remove `!important`, trim the value and convert the name with -([a-z]) to camelCase (so -webkit-user-select becomes WebkitUserSelect).

Tally category, composite-form and unsupported kinds by property. For structural kinds, tally structuralOk when structuralAllowed(name, value) or structuralAllowed(name, Number(value)) holds, otherwise structuralForbidden.
The utilities measurement first cut the `@layer utilities{...}` block out of the renderer stylesheet by brace matching.

recordedRuns.note: First run over the whole renderer stylesheet before the utilities block was cut out. It was not reported.

reconstructedClassifier.policy: the same pinned Alpha 1 policy module, loaded from its digested bytes
differencesFromOriginal: Declarations come from a CSS parser instead of a regular expression; on both inputs the two extractions yield identical (property, value) multisets.
Excluded declarations (custom properties, @keyframes frames, layers outside the measured block) stay in the set with a reason instead of disappearing.
Each declaration is also bound to its CE-00.1 registry entry and proof fixture, annotated with boundary flags and, for composites, with the longhands a rewrite needs.

calibrationLimits.title: Numeric coercion
calibrationLimits.statement: The original retried each structural value as a JavaScript number. These declarations count as expressible only because a JavaScript number could be authored. The note's prose says string values such as "0.6" are refused; its counts include the coercion.

calibrationLimits.title: Category-bound values are not checked
calibrationLimits.statement: A category-bound property counts as expressible whatever its value. Raw values become expressible only through a token of that category; keywords, multi-value, negative or invalid values are not examined. Value grammar is not validated at all.

calibrationLimits.title: Conditions are not checked
calibrationLimits.statement: Declarations under media queries, pseudo-classes or state attributes are classified on property and value only. Alpha 1 needs each condition declared in the design system.

calibrationLimits.title: Pseudo-elements are not checked
calibrationLimits.statement: Declarations on ::before, ::after or ::placeholder are counted on property and value although Alpha 1 has no pseudo-element authoring.

calibrationLimits.title: Only five composite forms
calibrationLimits.statement: Only background, border, font, animation and transition count as composite rewrites. A background that is a single color rewrites to background-color; the other composites reset longhands that Alpha 1 does not admit. Other shorthands (border-top, outline, text-decoration, list-style, place-items, flex, inset, grid-column) count as gaps, not rewrites.

calibrationLimits.title: Font-face descriptors counted as declarations
calibrationLimits.statement: @font-face descriptors are counted like properties: font-family and font-weight as expressible, src and font-display as gaps. font-display has no CE-00.1 registry entry.

calibrationLimits.title: Vendor-prefixed names counted as absent properties
calibrationLimits.statement: Vendor-prefixed declarations are counted as absent properties; the CE-00.1 registry disposes of them separately.

calibrationLimits.title: !important ignored
calibrationLimits.statement: The original removed !important before classifying; Alpha 1 has no !important authoring.

calibrationLimits.title: Reported denominator is not the full stylesheet
calibrationLimits.statement: The reported totals exclude custom properties, @keyframes frames and, for the utilities input, the reset, base and tokens layers. The sets keep those declarations with their reason; the full denominators are the set totals.

calibrationLimits.title: Different kinds of denominator
calibrationLimits.statement: The utilities block lists each atomic declaration once, however many components use it. The mockup lists every authored declaration, repeated ones included. The two totals are not comparable rates.

calibrationLimits.title: Utilities input byte identity
calibrationLimits.statement: The utilities input is a rebuild from unchanged sources. Its span and all bucket counts match the original run, but its bytes cannot be proven identical to the measured file.

calibrationLimits.title: Policy-level evidence only
calibrationLimits.statement: Expressible means the Alpha 1 policy module admits the property and value. It is not compiler acceptance (E2), emitted CSS (E3) or rendered behavior (E4). A declaration counted expressible can still fail to reproduce its rendering.

separateGates: The consumer's badge comparison script (blob 8a97a049f1a9a3117342532c66ca407d1a6ecfbd) compares computed badge styles and border boxes under CSP in Chromium. It is not this classifier, is not used here and stays a separate rendering check.
Rendered and behavioral fidelity is CE-FX-CAP-45-render-behavior-fidelity (E4), owned by CE-14. Calibration closes no rendering, state, accessibility or CSP claim.
The zero-unexpressible full-denominator proof is CE-FX-CAP-45-full-denominator-zero-unexpressible, owned by CE-14 against the canonical catalog, not the Alpha 1 policy.
